title: Antibiotic stewardship: balancing patient care and public health
html: Antimicrobial resistance is a global public health threat associated with increased mortality and substantial health care costs.1 Although national data show continued decreases in antibiotic prescribing by medical clinicians, dental antibiotic prescribing remained essentially unchanged from 2012 through 2022, so that dentists now account for more than 10% of all outpatient antibiotic prescriptions.2,3 During this period, prescribing rates for amoxicillin increased significantly, with disproportionately higher rates observed among dental specialists, particularly oral and maxillofacial surgeons, due in part to their broader scope of practice and management of more complex surgical procedures.
